title: Reval Rebel psychological spell (spirit-duel word spell, ADR 0048)
description: One social move of the spirit duel: an element, a push on one or two soul lights, a willpower cost and authored lines. Semantic rules the subset validator cannot express (non-zero deltas, kind/sign agreement, element/light pairing, line keys, starters) live in tools/validate_content_record_gameplay.py.

element.description: Duel element (colour and slot sigil family). Must be guarded by one of the lights in light_vector.

delta.description: Signed shift of the opponent's duel copy of this light; never 0.

cost.description: Willpower spent by a free cast; answering a reply is free.

starter.description: Known from the start of the game; the five starters are today's word spells.

guilt.description: Weights added to each guilt school once per resident when the spell is spoken (GuiltLedger).

lines.description: Authored lines by context: answer.<move kind>, topic.<topic id>, weak, default. Picked in that priority; within a context lines rotate by how often the spell was spoken in the duel.
